description: Create a time entry in the current matter. dateWorked, timezoneId, durationMinutes, and narrative are required; workItemId is optional. The timekeeper's effective matter rate is resolved server-side. durations are whole minutes. Returns the time entry ID.

anyOf.description: UTBMS/LEDES activity code; pass null to clear

billable.description: Whether the entry is billable to the client

dateWorked.description: Date the work was done (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

anyOf.description: BCP-47 language tag, or null when unspecified
UTBMS/LEDES task code; pass null to clear

timezoneId.description: IANA time zone the dateWorked is interpreted in (e.g. Europe/Prague)

anyOf.description: Optional document, folder, or task that provides context for the work
